details: Package demo-awesome-date-formater-test@0.0.6 is a typosquat that depends on the known-malicious package demo-awesome-date-parser-test@0.0.6. The formater package is a heavily obfuscated thin wrapper that does nothing except import and re-export the malicious dependency. The dependency (demo-awesome-date-parser-test) contains a 143KB javascript-obfuscator payload that monitors clipboard content and injects client-side code, using base64-js, jquery, and moment as cover dependencies. The require path in the formater code ('demo-awesome-date-parser') does not match the declared dependency name, confirming the typosquat/dependency-confusion attack pattern.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
